endonym.value: [what stands, and what stands against it]
endonym.gloss: the same figure that opens a dealing

description.value: A sequence of posed positions with settled answers, struck between choruses, in which each riddle is a ledger that cannot be closed and the answer is the one form of words that leaves it open. Getting one wrong is not a failure of wit but a statement about standing, and is entered on the tally.

content.value:
I hold four of yours and you hold none of mine. What am I?

You are a chorus that will be tending my beds within the year. Take one back.

I hold nothing of yours and you hold nothing of mine, and we have struck at one another for sixty years. What are we?

Strangers. Cut something.
